subject.title: feat(gateway): auto-approve node pairing via SSH device-key verification

question: Should an omitted `gateway.nodes.pairing.sshVerify` setting enable automatic node enrollment and first-surface approval for existing gateways after upgrade?
rationale: This changes the default authorization evidence and operator-consent model for a security boundary; code correctness cannot determine the intended product policy.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep manual pairing as the default and let operators enable SSH verification after reviewing its trust and SSH configuration prerequisites.

options.title: Approve default-on rollout
options.body: Retain default-on behavior only with explicit security-owner approval, upgrade communication, and fresh-install plus upgrade live proof.

options.title: Split the regression repair
options.body: Land only the dormant non-interactive capability-request repair and defer SSH-based enrollment policy.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep manual pairing as the default and let operators enable SSH verification after reviewing its trust and SSH configuration prerequisites.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history places this person closest to the current pairing architecture, adjacent auto-approval policy, and linked product proposal.
